title: Partner Overview Tour
description: Browse and manage partner organizations with comprehensive search, filtering, and CRUD operations. Central hub for all partner-related activities.

popover.title: Welcome to PartnerComponent
popover.description: This page allows users to browse, search, filter, and manage partner organizations. It serves as the central hub for all partner-related activities, providing an overview of existing partners and options to create new ones or import data.

popover.title: New Partner | Edit Partner
popover.description:
This button opens a dialog for creating a new partner or editing an existing one. It provides comprehensive form fields to manage all organizational information, contacts, and business relationships.

When to use: When you need to add a brand new partner organization to the system., When you need to update details for an existing partner, such as their name, type, or contact information.

popover.title: Import Partners
popover.description:
This button opens a dialog that allows you to bulk import multiple partner organizations from external sources like Google Sheets or CSV files.

When to use: When you have a large list of partners to add and want to avoid manual entry., During initial system setup or data migration from another system.

popover.title: Tour Complete!
popover.description: You've learned the key features of Partner. You can always restart this tour from the help menu.
